You can remove most phone batteries fairly easily, albeit with the right tools. Take an iPhone for example. All you need to do is unscrew the proprietary pentalobe screws on the bottom of the device, suction cup the screen off (but not too much because you might rip your home button ribbon). Then disconnect that ribbon, unscrew the metal plate holding the battery ribbon in place, then use a heat gun pointed directly at the battery while on medium heat while simultaneously running a flathead screwdriver along the edges of the battery until it comes off! Easy!

In reality though, it's partially so they can charge out the ass for repairs, and partially because the main reason people took their phone batteries out was to hard reset their device, and in all android and iOS devices, there is a hardware failsafe for doing this.
